content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to keep the device's retentive memory after reloading the program? We can manually read the hour counter value before reloading the software, but I'm unsure how to retain the value of an up/down counter after reload. Any suggestions would be appreciated.
Record the V/R counter value before making any program changes. When updating the program, set this number as the initial value in the V/R counter properties before loading it back into the device.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about losing retentive memory data, especially counter values, when reloading a program on the hardware. Counter blocks, such as hour counters, can be manually handled, but up/down counters require extra effort to preserve values. The workflow relies on manual operations, increasing the risk of error and making the process less efficient.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the system to automatically retain or easily recover all retentive memory values, including up/down counters, after a program reload, reducing manual intervention and the chance for mistakes.
